subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard add a durable `ready_to_merge` status and fail-closed completion gate in this PR, or should the review lifecycle stay within the existing `review`/`done` status model for now?
rationale: The PR changes stored Workboard status semantics and existing completion behavior, so maintainers need to accept the lifecycle contract before a repair worker can safely finish the implementation direction.

options.title: Repair and accept the lifecycle
options.body: Preserve existing response contracts, require review proof for all completion paths, declare the new tool/status everywhere, and require upgrade plus real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Use existing statuses only
options.body: Drop `ready_to_merge` and model approvals within the existing `review` to `done` flow to avoid introducing a new durable state.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Keep the production bypass open for a narrower owner-designed Workboard review-gate change if the durable status/tool direction is not accepted.

recommendation.title: Repair and accept the lifecycle
recommendation.body: Preserve existing response contracts, require review proof for all completion paths, declare the new tool/status everywhere, and require upgrade plus real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest Workboard feature-history signal across the tool, status, persistence, and plugin metadata surfaces touched by this PR.
